verdict.rationale: ReelMimic lets creators scrub to any second and leave notes on the finished video, or request changes in chat. Its pipeline is built per shot, with each shot handled and reviewed by a separate agent, which implies segment-targeted revisions. Nothing explicitly says a fix re-renders only the affected segment rather than the whole video, and extending a clip is never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit segment-only regeneration without full re-render, clip extension capability, hands-on or independent corroboration.
